entities.summary: Yauheni Zharnasek, also known as Yevgeny Zhernosek, is a Belarusian weightlifter. He competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the +105 kg event. In October 2016, the IOC disqualified him from the 2012 Olympics and annulled his result after his Olympic doping sample was retested and failed.
